command: set -euo pipefail; echo "external=external shards=4 namespaces=m19p2s0..m19p2s3 ci_not_run=1"; node --check scripts/test-shards.mjs; node --check scripts/test-merge-shards.mjs; node scripts/test-shards.mjs --check; ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/ci.yml"); puts "yaml ok"'; git diff --check; echo "diff-check ok"; ROOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-shards"; rm -rf "$ROOT"; mkdir -p "$ROOT"; for s in 0 1 2 3; do NS="m19p2s$s"; echo "=== shard $s namespace $NS ==="; node scripts/test-services.mjs reset --namespace "$NS"; rm -rf apps/*/target/surefire-reports platform/*/target/surefire-reports; FILTER="$(node scripts/test-shards.mjs --shard "$s" --print-test-filter)"; node scripts/test-shards.mjs --shard "$s" --emit --out-dir "$ROOT/shard-$s/.ci/test-shards" >/dev/null; echo "filter_chars=${#FILTER}"; START=$(date +%s); RICCON_TEST_SERVICES=external RICCON_TEST_SERVICES_NAMESPACE="$NS" perl -e 'alarm shift; exec @ARGV' 1500 ./mvnw -q -T1C test -Dtest="$FILTER" -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -Djacoco.skip=true; END=$(date +%s); printf '{"shard":%s,"wall_seconds":%s}\n' "$s" "$((END-START))" > "$ROOT/shard-$s/.ci/test-shards/shard-$s-timings.json"; node scripts/test-timings.mjs --out-dir "$ROOT/shard-$s/.ci/test-timings"; for d in apps/*/target/surefire-reports platform/*/target/surefire-reports; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then mkdir -p "$ROOT/shard-$s/$d"; cp "$d"/TEST-*.xml "$ROOT/shard-$s/$d/"; fi; done; echo "shard=$s wall=$((END-START))s"; done; node scripts/test-merge-shards.mjs --shards-root "$ROOT" --baseline scripts/test-shards-baseline.json --out-dir "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-merged"; FULL="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-full"; rm -rf "$FULL"; mkdir -p "$FULL"; for s in 0 1 2 3; do cp -R "$ROOT/shard-$s/apps" "$FULL/" 2>/dev/null || true; cp -R "$ROOT/shard-$s/platform" "$FULL/" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo "full_reports=$(find "$FULL" -name 'TEST-*.xml' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; SIM="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-sim"; rm -rf "$SIM"; node scripts/test-shards.mjs --simulate "$SIM" --reports-root "$FULL"; node scripts/test-merge-shards.mjs --shards-root "$SIM" --out-dir "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-sim-merged"; DUP="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-dup"; rm -rf "$DUP"; cp -R "$ROOT" "$DUP"; REL=$(cd "$DUP/shard-0" && find . -name 'TEST-*.xml' | head -1 | sed 's|^\./||'); mkdir -p "$DUP/shard-3/$(dirname "$REL")"; cp "$DUP/shard-0/$REL" "$DUP/shard-3/$REL"; if node scripts/test-merge-shards.mjs --shards-root "$DUP" --out-dir "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-dup-out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "NEGATIVE duplicate UNEXPECTEDLY PASSED"; exit 1; fi; echo "negative duplicate: non-zero as expected"; MISS="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-miss"; rm -rf "$MISS"; cp -R "$ROOT" "$MISS"; rm "$(find "$MISS/shard-2" -name 'TEST-*.xml' | head -1)"; if node scripts/test-merge-shards.mjs --shards-root "$MISS" --out-dir "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-miss-out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "NEGATIVE missing UNEXPECTEDLY PASSED"; exit 1; fi; echo "negative missing: non-zero as expected"; EXTRA="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-extra"; rm -rf "$EXTRA"; cp -R "$ROOT" "$EXTRA"; for s in 0 1 2 3; do mkdir -p "$EXTRA/shard-$s/apps/api/target/surefire-reports"; printf '%s\n' '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' '<testsuite name="com.riccon.api.UnregisteredShardTest" time="0.1" tests="1" errors="0" skipped="0" failures="0">' '</testsuite>' > "$EXTRA/shard-$s/apps/api/target/surefire-reports/TEST-com.riccon.api.UnregisteredShardTest.xml"; done; if node scripts/test-merge-shards.mjs --shards-root "$EXTRA" --out-dir "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m19p2-evidence-extra-out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "NEGATIVE unregistered UNEXPECTEDLY PASSED"; exit 1; fi; echo "negative unregistered new class: non-zero as expected"; echo "ALL CHECKS PASSED"
note: M19 P2 本地 4-shard 真跑（顺序、共享 compose、独立 namespace m19p2s0..m19p2s3、external 模式）；合并 193 类/1101 用例/0 failure/0 error/0 skip；含 --simulate 正向与重复/缺失/未登记类负向断言；YAML/语法/diff 检查通过；GitHub Actions 未运行，分片墙钟见日志 shard=N wall=Ns，CI 关键路径为估算
